create.name: Yoga Coolhaven
create.bio:
Yoga Coolhaven is an Iyengar yoga studio on the Coolhaven harbour in Rotterdam, run by a collective of certified teachers who set it up together and organise it through a non-profit foundation, Stichting Yoga Teachers Collective. Its large, light practice room has rope walls and a full set of props, and the teachers, several of whom study regularly with the Iyengar family in Pune, each bring their own style to a shared method built on precise instruction and careful adjustment of each posture to the student.

The weekly timetable runs from basics classes for newcomers, with headstand and shoulderstand taught step by step, through all-level groups to an intermediate class working on balances, twists and inversion variations, alongside quieter restorative evenings and classes for older students. Experienced students can join some sessions by live stream, and a library of recorded classes supports home practice. Beyond the mat, the studio runs a seasonal in-depth course that combines asana training on the Level 1 syllabus with study of philosophy and anatomy, holiday workshops, and a reading group on classic texts such as the Bhagavad Gita. Through its foundation it also takes yoga outdoors and into the neighbourhood with community projects.

courses.title: Unlimited membership
courses.description: A monthly membership covering all regular studio and online classes, with the video library included at no extra charge. A six-month commitment brings the monthly rate down; credit cards and a trial month for newcomers are listed on the same page.

courses.title: Iyengar Basics
courses.description: A slower-paced weekly class for beginners and for regular students who want to revisit the foundations. Standing, seated and supine postures are taught in detail, with headstand and shoulderstand introduced in stages and a closing period of rest in Savasana.

courses.title: Iyengar Intermediate
courses.description: A weekly class for practitioners already at home in headstand, shoulderstand and backbends. Alongside the core postures it brings in inversion variations, arm balances and more demanding twists, one step at a time.

courses.title: Live-Stream
courses.description: Selected classes from the timetable are taught over Zoom for students who practise at home. They are open to those with at least a year of Iyengar practice at the studio, who are confident in the inversions and have their own props.

courses.title: Cool Video Recording
courses.description: A rental library of full-length recorded classes, each about ninety minutes, for practising at a time that suits you. Each rental uses one credit and stays open for a week; members can watch without charge.
courses.price: 1 credit per video (free with a membership)
